Keep 25-35px top and side safe margins. No backing plates, containers, shadows under panels, pill shapes, full-width line or header, no title anywhere, no extra labels, no added UI. Top gameplay art must remain visible behind text. Preserve original aspect ratio. This is a local UI cleanup edit, not redesigning the game art.

Match small heart size about 28-32px per icon, generous 25-35px edge margins. No panels or pill containers behind anything. Keep the in-world gravity gates on the rail and their arrows unchanged; only remove the old large HUD gravity badge to leave center exclusively for score.
